text: Before Desmond writes a line of EmberStake.sol, he has to settle exactly what it tracks: how much $EMBER each staker has locked up, and how much ETH they've earned.
Three functions: stake and withdraw move $EMBER principal, and claimRewards pays out ETH -- all at the signature level for now, no bodies yet.
Two mappings carry the whole design: stakedBalance for principal, rewardBalance for claimable ETH, plus a running totalStaked.
Rewards accrue from protocol fees, proportional to stake, using a running reward-per-token accumulator instead of looping over every staker.
Next: planning how this design actually gets tested -- and how it gets tested against someone trying to break it.
